description.p: CsoundQt is a feature-rich, cross-platform frontend and IDE for csound. csound itself is a powerful sound synthesis and music programming language.

It provides a syntax-highlighting code editor with autocomplete, interactive widget panels for real-time control, an integrated debugger, quick access to help for any opcode, MIDI and OSC support and a variety of tools for composing and performing
CsoundQt ships with an extensive collection of examples covering everything from basic synthesis techniques to advanced signal processing
CsoundQt 7 is a major new version with a complete port to Qt 6 and Csound 7, along with many improvements and optimizations:

ul.li: Port to Qt 6 (dropped Qt 5 and WebKit support)
Replaced Live Event Sheets with live code evaluation and Scratch Pad
New application icon and splash screen
Major performance optimizations for widget channel handling
Renamed from QuteCsound to CsoundQt throughout
Fixed most warnings and problems reported by code analysis
